32.old: 55+ and 45+ age-restricted condos are strata-titled under the BC Strata Property Act. Request Form B, the last two years of strata minutes, the depreciation report and the bylaws (rentals, pets and age restrictions) before removing subjects; 55+ and 45+ complexes enforce age bylaws that apply to at least one occupant.
32.new: The BC Strata Property Act governs strata title for 55+ and 45+ age-restricted condos. Prior to removing subjects, obtain the depreciation report, Form B, the strata minutes from the last two years and the bylaws, including those on age restrictions, pets and rentals. In these complexes the age bylaws must be met by at least one occupant.

34.new: Floodplain: lower Sardis, along with parts of Fairfield Island, Greendale, Rosedale and Yarrow, is in the Fraser and Vedder River floodplain; the City's dike network is what protects these areas. For any property, ask about its flood construction level, the requirements of lenders and insurers, and whether title has a geotechnical or floodplain covenant registered.

36.new: Schools and transit: Chilliwack falls under School District 33 (SD33). Its schools include Chilliwack Secondary, Sardis Secondary and G.W.
